statement: Find all pairs \((x,y)\) of integers such that \(x^3 - y^3 = 2xy + 8\).
A parallelepiped with side lengths \(a, b, c\) is cut by a plane through the intersection of its diagonals, perpendicular to one of those diagonals. Calculate the area of the cross-section.
Let \(a, b, m\) be positive integers. Prove that there exists a positive integer \(n\) such that \((a^n-1)b\) is divisible by \(m\) if and only if \(\gcd(ab, m) = \gcd(b, m)\).
Find all real values of \(a\) for which the equation \(16x^4 - ax^3 + (2a+17)x^2 - ax + 16 = 0\) has four solutions forming an arithmetic progression.

A pyramid \(O.ABC\) has the property that the altitudes from \(A, B, C\) in the base are not less than \(\dfrac{OB+OC}{2}\), \(\dfrac{OC+OA}{2}\), \(\dfrac{OA+OB}{2}\) respectively. Given that the area of \(ABC\) is \(S\), calculate the volume of the pyramid.
